CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER = [
    "top 1",
    "top 2",
    "top 3",
    "other multi",
    "monomers",
]


def filter_fixed(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    fixed: dict[str, object] | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Filter a dataframe by exact column values."""
    if fixed is None:
        return df.copy()

    out = df.copy()

    for col, value in fixed.items():
        out = out[out[col] == value]

    return out.copy()


def add_cluster_bin(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    top_n: int = 3,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Add plotting category:
        Top 1, Top 2, Top 3, Other multimers, Monomers
    """
    out = df.copy()

    out["cluster_bin"] = "other multi"

    monomer_mask = out["cluster_kind"] == "monomers"
    out.loc[monomer_mask, "cluster_bin"] = "monomers"

    for rank in range(1, top_n + 1):
        rank_mask = (
            (out["cluster_kind"] == "cluster")
            & (out["cluster_rank_particles"] == rank)
        )
        out.loc[rank_mask, "cluster_bin"] = f"top {rank}"

    return out


def select_last_fraction_frames(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    fraction_last: float = 0.1,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Return run/frame keys belonging to the final fraction of frames per replicate.
    """
    if not 0 < fraction_last <= 1:
        raise ValueError("fraction_last must be in (0, 1].")

    frame_df = (
        df[[run_col, frame_col, sort_col]]
        .drop_duplicates()
        .sort_values([run_col, sort_col])
    )

    chunks = []

    for _, d in frame_df.groupby(run_col):
        n_last = max(1, int(np.ceil(len(d) * fraction_last)))
        chunks.append(d.tail(n_last)[[run_col, frame_col]])

    return pd.concat(chunks, ignore_index=True)

def make_cluster_stack_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    group_cols: list[str],
    value_col_cag10: str,
    value_col_cag47: str,
    fraction_last: float = 0.1,
    top_n: int = 3,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Summarize cluster-resolved rows for stacked bar plots.

    Bar heights come from value_col_cag10/value_col_cag47.
    Annotations come from mean n_mols_cag10 / n_mols_cag47.

    Other multimers = all multimer clusters with rank > top_n.
    Monomers = aggregated monomer row.
    """
    df = add_cluster_bin(df, top_n=top_n)

    late_keys = select_last_fraction_frames(
        df=df,
        fraction_last=fraction_last,
        run_col=run_col,
        frame_col=frame_col,
        sort_col=sort_col,
    )

    late_df = df.merge(
        late_keys,
        on=[run_col, frame_col],
        how="inner",
    )

    frame_group_cols = [
        *group_cols,
        run_col,
        frame_col,
        "cluster_bin",
    ]

    frame_cat = (
        late_df
        .groupby(frame_group_cols, as_index=False)
        .agg(
            cag10_value=(value_col_cag10, "sum"),
            cag47_value=(value_col_cag47, "sum"),
            cag10_mols=("n_mols_cag10", "sum"),
            cag47_mols=("n_mols_cag47", "sum"),
            n_clusters_aggregated=("n_clusters_aggregated", "sum"),
        )
    )

    # Fill missing bins with zero
    frame_base = late_df[
        [*group_cols, run_col, frame_col]
    ].drop_duplicates()

    category_df = pd.DataFrame({"cluster_bin": CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER})

    grid = (
        frame_base.assign(_tmp=1)
        .merge(category_df.assign(_tmp=1), on="_tmp")
        .drop(columns="_tmp")
    )

    frame_cat = grid.merge(
        frame_cat,
        on=[*group_cols, run_col, frame_col, "cluster_bin"],
        how="left",
    )

    fill_cols = [
        "cag10_value",
        "cag47_value",
        "cag10_mols",
        "cag47_mols",
        "n_clusters_aggregated",
    ]
    frame_cat[fill_cols] = frame_cat[fill_cols].fillna(0.0)

    rep_summary = (
        frame_cat
        .groupby([*group_cols, run_col, "cluster_bin"], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            cag10_mean=("cag10_value", "mean"),
            cag47_mean=("cag47_value", "mean"),
            cag10_mols_mean=("cag10_mols", "mean"),
            cag47_mols_mean=("cag47_mols", "mean"),
            n_clusters_aggregated_mean=("n_clusters_aggregated", "mean"),
        )
    )

    summary = (
        rep_summary
        .groupby([*group_cols, "cluster_bin"], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            cag10_mean=("cag10_mean", "mean"),
            cag47_mean=("cag47_mean", "mean"),
            cag10_mols_mean=("cag10_mols_mean", "mean"),
            cag47_mols_mean=("cag47_mols_mean", "mean"),
            n_clusters_aggregated_mean=("n_clusters_aggregated_mean", "mean"),
            n_replicates=(run_col, "nunique"),
        )
    )

    summary["total_mean"] = summary["cag10_mean"] + summary["cag47_mean"]
    summary["total_mols_mean"] = (
        summary["cag10_mols_mean"] + summary["cag47_mols_mean"]
    )

    return summary, rep_summary

def make_cluster_stack_suptitle(
    title: str,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    fixed: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    fraction_last: float = 0.1,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
) -> str:
    """
    Make figure title in the same style as the other panel plots.

    Example:
        Cluster material distribution, rho = 0.005
        (last 10% of steps, 10 replicates)
    """
    title_parts = [title]

    if fixed is not None:
        fixed_parts = []

        for col, value in fixed.items():
            fixed_parts.append(f"{get_label(col, label_map)} = {value:g}")

        if fixed_parts:
            title_parts.append(", ".join(fixed_parts))

    pct = int(round(fraction_last * 100))

    n_reps = df[run_col].nunique() if run_col in df.columns else None

    if n_reps is not None:
        rep_word = "replicate" if n_reps == 1 else "replicates"
        suffix = f"(last {pct}% of steps, {n_reps} {rep_word})"
    else:
        suffix = f"(last {pct}% of steps)"

    return f"{', '.join(title_parts)} {suffix}"

def plot_cluster_stack_panel(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    ax: plt.Axes,
    title: str,
    y_label: str,
    style: PlotStyle | None = None,
    ylim: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
    annotate_mols: bool = True,
) -> plt.Axes:
    """
    Plot one stacked cluster-material panel.

    Bar height = fraction of total system particles in that category.
    Blue annotation = mean number of CAG10 molecules.
    Red annotation = mean number of CAG47 molecules.
    """
    if style is None:
        style = PlotStyle()

    d = (
        summary_df
        .set_index("cluster_bin")
        .reindex(CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER)
        .fillna(0.0)
    )

    x = np.arange(len(CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER))

    # keep your colors
    cag10_fill = "#5aafdc"
    cag47_fill = "#eb5353"

    cag10_text = "#08519c"
    cag47_text = "#cb181d"

    ax.bar(
        x,
        d["cag10_mean"],
        label="CAG10",
        color=cag10_fill,
        edgecolor="none",
        width=0.78,
    )

    ax.bar(
        x,
        d["cag47_mean"],
        bottom=d["cag10_mean"],
        label="CAG47",
        color=cag47_fill,
        edgecolor="none",
        width=0.78,
    )

    if annotate_mols:
        for i, cluster_bin in enumerate(CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER):
            total_height = float(d.loc[cluster_bin, "total_mean"])
            n10 = float(d.loc[cluster_bin, "cag10_mols_mean"])
            n47 = float(d.loc[cluster_bin, "cag47_mols_mean"])

            if total_height <= 0:
                continue

            ax.text(
                i,
                total_height + 0.015,
                f"{n10:.1f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=12,
                color=cag10_text,
                fontweight="medium",
            )

            ax.text(
                i,
                total_height + 0.075,
                f"{n47:.1f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=12,
                color=cag47_text,
                fontweight="medium",
            )

    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=style.panel_title_size)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels(CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER, rotation=30, ha="right")
    ax.set_ylabel(y_label, fontsize=style.label_size)

    ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=style.tick_size)

    if ylim is not None:
        ax.set_ylim(*ylim)

    if style.show_grid:
        ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

    return ax

def plot_cluster_stack_panels(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    panel_cols: list[str],
    y_label: str,
    source_df: pd.DataFrame,
    fixed: dict[str, object] | None = None,
    fraction_last: float = 0.1,
    title: str = "Cluster material distribution",
    ylim: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
    n_cols: int = 3,
    figsize_per_panel: tuple[float, float] = (5.3, 5.2),
    style: PlotStyle | None = None,
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
) -> tuple[plt.Figure, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Make one stacked bar panel per parameter combination.

    Uses LABEL_MAP for panel labels and automatic figure title formatting.
    """
    if style is None:
        style = PlotStyle()

    with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
        panel_df = (
            summary_df[panel_cols]
            .drop_duplicates()
            .sort_values(panel_cols)
            .reset_index(drop=True)
        )

        n_panels = len(panel_df)
        n_rows = math.ceil(n_panels / n_cols)

        fig, axes = plt.subplots(
            n_rows,
            n_cols,
            figsize=(
                figsize_per_panel[0] * n_cols,
                figsize_per_panel[1] * n_rows,
            ),
            squeeze=False,
            sharey=ylim is not None,
        )

        axes_flat = axes.ravel()

        for ax_idx, (_, panel_vals) in enumerate(panel_df.iterrows()):
            ax = axes_flat[ax_idx]

            mask = np.ones(len(summary_df), dtype=bool)
            group_values = []

            for col in panel_cols:
                value = panel_vals[col]
                mask &= summary_df[col] == value
                group_values.append(value)

            d = summary_df[mask]

            panel_title = make_panel_title(
                group_values=tuple(group_values),
                panel_cols=panel_cols,
                label_map=label_map,
            )

            plot_cluster_stack_panel(
                summary_df=d,
                ax=ax,
                title=panel_title,
                y_label=y_label,
                style=style,
                ylim=ylim,
                annotate_mols=True,
            )

        for ax in axes_flat[n_panels:]:
            ax.axis("off")

        handles, labels = axes_flat[0].get_legend_handles_labels()

        fig.legend(
            handles,
            labels,
            loc="lower center",
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.03),
            ncol=2,
            frameon=True,
            title="RNA",
            fontsize=style.legend_size,
        )

        suptitle = make_cluster_stack_suptitle(
            title=title,
            df=source_df,
            fixed=fixed,
            fraction_last=fraction_last,
            run_col=run_col,
            label_map=label_map,
        )

        fig.suptitle(
            suptitle,
            y=0.91,
            fontsize=style.title_size,
        )

        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0.02, 0.13, 0.98, 0.93))

    return fig, axes

def make_top1_contact_fraction_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    group_cols: list[str],
    fraction_last: float = 0.15,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Summarize inter-contact composition of the largest cluster.

    Uses only:
        cluster_kind == "cluster"
        cluster_rank_particles == 1

    Fractions are calculated per frame, then averaged over the final
    fraction per replicate, then averaged across replicates.
    """
    top1 = df[
        (df["cluster_kind"] == "cluster")
        & (df["cluster_rank_particles"] == 1)
    ].copy()

    required_cols = [
        *group_cols,
        run_col,
        frame_col,
        sort_col,
        "inter_particle_contacts_total",
        "inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag10",
        "inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag47",
        "inter_particle_contacts_cag47_cag47",
    ]

    missing_cols = [col for col in required_cols if col not in top1.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns: {missing_cols}")

    denom = top1["inter_particle_contacts_total"].replace(0, np.nan)

    top1["frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag10_cag10"] = (
        top1["inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag10"] / denom
    )

    top1["frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag10_cag47"] = (
        top1["inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag47"] / denom
    )

    top1["frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag47_cag47"] = (
        top1["inter_particle_contacts_cag47_cag47"] / denom
    )

    late_keys = select_last_fraction_frames(
        df=top1,
        fraction_last=fraction_last,
        run_col=run_col,
        frame_col=frame_col,
        sort_col=sort_col,
    )

    late_top1 = top1.merge(
        late_keys,
        on=[run_col, frame_col],
        how="inner",
    )

    rep_summary = (
        late_top1
        .groupby([*group_cols, run_col], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            frac_cag10_cag10_mean=(
                "frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag10_cag10",
                "mean",
            ),
            frac_cag10_cag47_mean=(
                "frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag10_cag47",
                "mean",
            ),
            frac_cag47_cag47_mean=(
                "frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag47_cag47",
                "mean",
            ),
            inter_contacts_total_mean=(
                "inter_particle_contacts_total",
                "mean",
            ),
            inter_contacts_cag10_cag10_mean=(
                "inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag10",
                "mean",
            ),
            inter_contacts_cag10_cag47_mean=(
                "inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag47",
                "mean",
            ),
            inter_contacts_cag47_cag47_mean=(
                "inter_particle_contacts_cag47_cag47",
                "mean",
            ),
            top1_particle_frac_mean=(
                "frac_total_particles_in_cluster",
                "mean",
            ),
            top1_cag10_particle_frac_mean=(
                "frac_cluster_particles_cag10",
                "mean",
            ),
            top1_cag47_particle_frac_mean=(
                "frac_cluster_particles_cag47",
                "mean",
            ),
        )
    )

    summary = (
        rep_summary
        .groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)
        .agg(
            frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag10_cag10=(
                "frac_cag10_cag10_mean",
                "mean",
            ),
            frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag10_cag47=(
                "frac_cag10_cag47_mean",
                "mean",
            ),
            frac_top1_inter_contacts_cag47_cag47=(
                "frac_cag47_cag47_mean",
                "mean",
            ),
            inter_contacts_total_mean=(
                "inter_contacts_total_mean",
                "mean",
            ),

            n_replicates=(run_col, "nunique"),
        )
    )

    return summary, rep_summary

def make_auto_title(
    title: str,
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    title_cols: list[str] | None = None,
    fraction_last: float | None = None,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
) -> str:
    """
    Make automatic title from constant values in the plotted dataframe.
    """
    title_parts = [title]

    if title_cols is not None:
        fixed_parts = []

        for col in title_cols:
            if col not in df.columns:
                continue

            values = sorted(df[col].dropna().unique())

            if len(values) == 1:
                value = values[0]

                if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
                    value_str = f"{value:g}"
                else:
                    value_str = str(value)

                fixed_parts.append(
                    f"{get_label(col, label_map)} = {value_str}"
                )

        if fixed_parts:
            title_parts.append(", ".join(fixed_parts))

    suffix_parts = []

    if fraction_last is not None:
        pct = int(round(fraction_last * 100))
        suffix_parts.append(f"last {pct}% of steps")

    if run_col in df.columns:
        n_reps = df[run_col].nunique()
        rep_word = "replicate" if n_reps == 1 else "replicates"
        suffix_parts.append(f"{n_reps} {rep_word}")

    if suffix_parts:
        return f"{', '.join(title_parts)} ({', '.join(suffix_parts)})"

    return ", ".join(title_parts)

def plot_top1_contact_fraction_bars(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    x_col: str = "E_att",
    style: PlotStyle | None = None,
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
    annotate_total_contacts: bool = True,
    annotate_segment_counts: bool = True,
    min_segment_height_for_text: float = 0.08,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (8.4, 5.8),
) -> tuple[plt.Figure, plt.Axes]:
    """
    Plot stacked bars showing inter-contact composition of the largest cluster.

    - Bar height = fraction of top-1 inter-contacts
    - Text inside each segment = mean raw count of that contact type
    - Text above each bar = mean total inter-contact count
    """
    if style is None:
        style = PlotStyle()

    with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
        d = summary_df.sort_values(x_col).copy()

        x_values = d[x_col].to_list()
        x = np.arange(len(x_values))

        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)

        bottom = np.zeros(len(d))

        for frac_col in TOP1_CONTACT_COLS:
            values = d[frac_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            bars = ax.bar(
                x,
                values,
                bottom=bottom,
                color=TOP1_CONTACT_COLORS[frac_col],
                label=TOP1_CONTACT_LABELS[frac_col],
                edgecolor="none",
                width=0.75,
            )

            if annotate_segment_counts:
                count_col = TOP1_CONTACT_COUNT_COLS[frac_col]
                raw_counts = d[count_col].to_numpy(dtype=float)

                for i, (bar, frac_val, raw_count, bot) in enumerate(
                    zip(bars, values, raw_counts, bottom)
                ):
                    if frac_val < min_segment_height_for_text:
                        continue

                    y = bot + frac_val / 2.0

                    ax.text(
                        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2.0,
                        y,
                        f"{raw_count:.0f}",
                        ha="center",
                        va="center",
                        fontsize=11,
                        color="white",
                        fontweight="medium",
                    )

            bottom += values

        if annotate_total_contacts:
            for i, (_, row) in enumerate(d.iterrows()):
                total_contacts = row["inter_contacts_total_mean"]

                ax.text(
                    i,
                    1.03,
                    f"N={total_contacts:.0f}",
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom",
                    fontsize=12,
                    color="black",
                )

        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels([
            f"{value:g}" if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating))
            else str(value)
            for value in x_values
        ])

        ax.set_xlabel(get_label(x_col, label_map))
        ax.set_ylabel("Fraction of inter-contacts")
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1.12)

        if style.show_grid:
            ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

        ax.legend(
            loc="lower center",
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.34),   # moved further down
            ncol=3,
            frameon=True,
            fontsize=13,
        )

        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0.02, 0.20, 0.98, 0.95))

    return fig, ax

def make_top1_metric_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    group_cols: list[str],
    metric_cols: list[str],
    fraction_last: float = 0.15,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Summarize metrics for the largest cluster only.

    Steps:
    1. Keep only the largest cluster per frame
    2. Keep only the final fraction of frames per replicate
    3. Average metrics over frames within each replicate
    4. Average replicate means across replicates
    """
    top1 = df[
        (df["cluster_kind"] == "cluster")
        & (df["cluster_rank_particles"] == 1)
    ].copy()

    late_keys = select_last_fraction_frames(
        df=top1,
        fraction_last=fraction_last,
        run_col=run_col,
        frame_col=frame_col,
        sort_col=sort_col,
    )

    late_top1 = top1.merge(
        late_keys,
        on=[run_col, frame_col],
        how="inner",
    )

    rep_summary = (
        late_top1
        .groupby([*group_cols, run_col], as_index=False)[metric_cols]
        .mean()
    )

    summary = (
        rep_summary
        .groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)[metric_cols]
        .mean()
    )

    nrep = (
        rep_summary
        .groupby(group_cols)[run_col]
        .nunique()
        .reset_index(name="n_replicates")
    )

    summary = summary.merge(nrep, on=group_cols, how="left")

    return late_top1, rep_summary, summary

def plot_species_metric_pairs(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    x_col: str,
    left_cols: list[str],
    right_cols: list[str],
    left_title: str,
    right_title: str,
    bar_labels: list[str],
    colors: list[str],
    y_label: str,
    style: PlotStyle,
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.2, 5.2),
    ylim: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
    legend_title: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[plt.Figure, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Make a 2-panel grouped bar plot.
    Left panel and right panel usually correspond to CAG10 and CAG47.
    """
    with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(
            1, 2,
            figsize=figsize,
            sharex=True,
            sharey=True,
            squeeze=False,
        )
        axes = axes.ravel()

        x_values = sorted(summary_df[x_col].dropna().unique())
        x = np.arange(len(x_values))
        width = 0.34

        d = summary_df.set_index(x_col).reindex(x_values)

        panel_specs = [
            (axes[0], left_cols, left_title),
            (axes[1], right_cols, right_title),
        ]

        for ax, cols, panel_title in panel_specs:
            offsets = [-width / 2, width / 2]

            for col, offset, color, label in zip(cols, offsets, colors, bar_labels):
                vals = d[col].to_numpy(dtype=float)

                ax.bar(
                    x + offset,
                    vals,
                    width=width,
                    color=color,
                    edgecolor="none",
                    label=label,
                )

            ax.set_title(panel_title)
            ax.set_xticks(x)
            ax.set_xticklabels([
                f"{v:g}" if isinstance(v, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)) else str(v)
                for v in x_values
            ])
            ax.set_xlabel(get_label(x_col, label_map))
            ax.set_ylabel(y_label)

            if ylim is not None:
                ax.set_ylim(*ylim)

            if style.show_grid:
                ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

        handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
        fig.legend(
            handles,
            labels,
            title=legend_title,
            loc="lower center",
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02),
            ncol=2,
            frameon=True,
            fontsize=style.legend_size + 1,
            title_fontsize=style.legend_title_size + 1,
        )

        if title is not None:
            fig.suptitle(title, y=0.98, fontsize=style.title_size)

        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0.02, 0.08, 0.98, 0.94))

    return fig, axes

def plot_top1_size_vs_connectivity(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    x_col: str,
    style: PlotStyle,
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.2, 5.2),
    title: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[plt.Figure, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Plot largest-cluster material fraction and mean molecule-graph degree.
    """
    with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(
            1, 2,
            figsize=figsize,
            sharex=True,
            squeeze=False,
        )
        axes = axes.ravel()

        x_values = sorted(summary_df[x_col].dropna().unique())
        x = np.arange(len(x_values))
        x_labels = [f"{v:g}" for v in x_values]

        d = summary_df.set_index(x_col).reindex(x_values)

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # Panel A: top-1 material fraction
        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        ax = axes[0]
        vals = d["frac_total_particles_in_cluster"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        ax.bar(
            x,
            vals,
            width=0.62,
            color="#606567",
            edgecolor="none",
        )

        if "cluster_size_mols" in d.columns:
            mol_counts = d["cluster_size_mols"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            for i, (y, n_mol) in enumerate(zip(vals, mol_counts)):
                ax.text(
                    i,
                    y + 0.035,
                    f"{n_mol:.1f} mol",
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom",
                    fontsize=style.tick_size,
                    color="#303030",
                    fontweight="medium",
                )

        ax.set_title("Largest-cluster material fraction")
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels)
        ax.set_xlabel(get_label(x_col, label_map))
        ax.set_ylabel("Fraction of total particles")
        ax.set_ylim(0, 1.10)

        if style.show_grid:
            ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        # Panel B: mean degree
        # ------------------------------------------------------------
        ax = axes[1]
        vals = d["mean_mol_graph_degree"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        ax.bar(
            x,
            vals,
            width=0.62,
            color="#9c9c9c",
            edgecolor="none",
        )

        y_max = np.nanmax(vals)

        if "mol_graph_edges" in d.columns:
            n_edges = d["mol_graph_edges"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            for i, (y, e) in enumerate(zip(vals, n_edges)):
                ax.text(
                    i,
                    y + 0.25,
                    f"{e:.0f} edges",
                    ha="center",
                    va="bottom",
                    fontsize=style.tick_size,
                    color="#303030",
                    fontweight="medium",
                )

        ax.set_title("Largest-cluster mean graph degree")
        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels(x_labels)
        ax.set_xlabel(get_label(x_col, label_map))
        ax.set_ylabel("Mean degree")
        ax.set_ylim(0, y_max + 0.9)

        if style.show_grid:
            ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

        if title is not None:
            fig.suptitle(title, y=0.98, fontsize=style.title_size)

        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0.02, 0.06, 0.98, 0.94))

    return fig, axes

def make_topn_inter_intra_saturation_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    group_cols: list[str],
    top_n: int = 2,
    fraction_last: float = 0.15,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Summarize inter/intra contact saturation across the top N clusters.

    Saturation is recomputed after summing contacts and available sites across
    top-ranked clusters within each frame.

    For CAG10:
        inter = (2*CAG10-CAG10 inter contacts + CAG10-CAG47 inter contacts)
                / available CAG10 sites

        intra = (2*CAG10 intra contacts)
                / available CAG10 sites

    For CAG47:
        inter = (2*CAG47-CAG47 inter contacts + CAG10-CAG47 inter contacts)
                / available CAG47 sites

        intra = (2*CAG47 intra contacts)
                / available CAG47 sites
    """
    top_df = df[
        (df["cluster_kind"] == "cluster")
        & (df["cluster_rank_particles"] <= top_n)
    ].copy()

    required_cols = [
        *group_cols,
        run_col,
        frame_col,
        sort_col,
        "inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag10",
        "inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag47",
        "inter_particle_contacts_cag47_cag47",
        "intra_particle_contacts_cag10",
        "intra_particle_contacts_cag47",
        "available_pairable_sites_cag10",
        "available_pairable_sites_cag47",
    ]

    missing_cols = [col for col in required_cols if col not in top_df.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns: {missing_cols}")

    late_keys = select_last_fraction_frames(
        df=top_df,
        fraction_last=fraction_last,
        run_col=run_col,
        frame_col=frame_col,
        sort_col=sort_col,
    )

    late_top_df = top_df.merge(
        late_keys,
        on=[run_col, frame_col],
        how="inner",
    )

    frame_summary = (
        late_top_df
        .groupby([*group_cols, run_col, frame_col, sort_col], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            inter_cag10_cag10=("inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag10", "sum"),
            inter_cag10_cag47=("inter_particle_contacts_cag10_cag47", "sum"),
            inter_cag47_cag47=("inter_particle_contacts_cag47_cag47", "sum"),
            intra_cag10=("intra_particle_contacts_cag10", "sum"),
            intra_cag47=("intra_particle_contacts_cag47", "sum"),
            available_sites_cag10=("available_pairable_sites_cag10", "sum"),
            available_sites_cag47=("available_pairable_sites_cag47", "sum"),
        )
    )

    frame_summary["topn_inter_saturation_cag10"] = (
        2 * frame_summary["inter_cag10_cag10"]
        + frame_summary["inter_cag10_cag47"]
    ) / frame_summary["available_sites_cag10"].replace(0, np.nan)

    frame_summary["topn_intra_saturation_cag10"] = (
        2 * frame_summary["intra_cag10"]
    ) / frame_summary["available_sites_cag10"].replace(0, np.nan)

    frame_summary["topn_inter_saturation_cag47"] = (
        2 * frame_summary["inter_cag47_cag47"]
        + frame_summary["inter_cag10_cag47"]
    ) / frame_summary["available_sites_cag47"].replace(0, np.nan)

    frame_summary["topn_intra_saturation_cag47"] = (
        2 * frame_summary["intra_cag47"]
    ) / frame_summary["available_sites_cag47"].replace(0, np.nan)

    metric_cols = [
        "topn_inter_saturation_cag10",
        "topn_intra_saturation_cag10",
        "topn_inter_saturation_cag47",
        "topn_intra_saturation_cag47",
    ]

    rep_summary = (
        frame_summary
        .groupby([*group_cols, run_col], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            topn_inter_saturation_cag10=("topn_inter_saturation_cag10", "mean"),
            topn_intra_saturation_cag10=("topn_intra_saturation_cag10", "mean"),
            topn_inter_saturation_cag47=("topn_inter_saturation_cag47", "mean"),
            topn_intra_saturation_cag47=("topn_intra_saturation_cag47", "mean"),
            available_sites_cag10=("available_sites_cag10", "mean"),
            available_sites_cag47=("available_sites_cag47", "mean"),
            inter_contacts_total=(
                "inter_cag10_cag10",
                "mean",
            ),
        )
    )

    summary = (
        rep_summary
        .groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)
        .agg(
            topn_inter_saturation_cag10=("topn_inter_saturation_cag10", "mean"),
            topn_intra_saturation_cag10=("topn_intra_saturation_cag10", "mean"),
            topn_inter_saturation_cag47=("topn_inter_saturation_cag47", "mean"),
            topn_intra_saturation_cag47=("topn_intra_saturation_cag47", "mean"),
            available_sites_cag10=("available_sites_cag10", "mean"),
            available_sites_cag47=("available_sites_cag47", "mean"),
            n_replicates=(run_col, "nunique"),
        )
    )

    return frame_summary, rep_summary, summary

def plot_topn_inter_intra_saturation(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    x_col: str = "E_att",
    top_n: int = 2,
    style: PlotStyle | None = None,
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
    title: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (10.2, 5.2),
    ylim: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
) -> tuple[plt.Figure, np.ndarray]:
    """
    Plot inter vs intra saturation across top N clusters.

    Left panel = CAG10.
    Right panel = CAG47.
    """
    if style is None:
        style = PlotStyle()

    with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
        d = summary_df.sort_values(x_col).copy()

        x_values = d[x_col].to_list()
        x = np.arange(len(x_values))

        width = 0.34

        fig, axes = plt.subplots(
            1,
            2,
            figsize=figsize,
            sharex=True,
            sharey=True,
        )

        specs = [
            {
                "ax": axes[0],
                "title": "CAG10",
                "inter_col": "topn_inter_saturation_cag10",
                "intra_col": "topn_intra_saturation_cag10",
            },
            {
                "ax": axes[1],
                "title": "CAG47",
                "inter_col": "topn_inter_saturation_cag47",
                "intra_col": "topn_intra_saturation_cag47",
            },
        ]

        colors = {
            "inter": "#5aafdc",
            "intra": "#eb5353",
        }

        for spec in specs:
            ax = spec["ax"]

            inter_vals = d[spec["inter_col"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            intra_vals = d[spec["intra_col"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)

            ax.bar(
                x - width / 2,
                inter_vals,
                width=width,
                color=colors["inter"],
                edgecolor="none",
                label="inter",
            )

            ax.bar(
                x + width / 2,
                intra_vals,
                width=width,
                color=colors["intra"],
                edgecolor="none",
                label="intra",
            )

            ax.set_title(spec["title"])
            ax.set_xticks(x)
            ax.set_xticklabels([
                f"{value:g}"
                if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating))
                else str(value)
                for value in x_values
            ])

            ax.set_xlabel(get_label(x_col, label_map))
            ax.set_ylabel("Contact saturation")

            if ylim is not None:
                ax.set_ylim(*ylim)

            if style.show_grid:
                ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

        handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()

        fig.legend(
            handles,
            labels,
            title="Contact type",
            loc="lower center",
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02),
            ncol=2,
            frameon=True,
            fontsize=style.legend_size,
            title_fontsize=style.legend_title_size,
        )

        if title is not None:
            fig.suptitle(
                title,
                y=0.98,
                fontsize=style.title_size,
            )

        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0.02, 0.10, 0.98, 0.93))

    return fig, axes

def make_top12_material_summary(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    group_cols: list[str],
    fraction_last: float = 0.15,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Summarize top-1 and top-1+top-2 material fractions.

    For each frame:
        top1_material = fraction of total particles in rank-1 cluster
        top2_extra_material = fraction of total particles in rank-2 cluster
        top12_material = top1 + top2

    Values are averaged over the final fraction of frames per replicate,
    then averaged across replicates.
    """
    top_df = df[
        (df["cluster_kind"] == "cluster")
        & (df["cluster_rank_particles"].isin([1, 2]))
    ].copy()

    late_keys = select_last_fraction_frames(
        df=df,
        fraction_last=fraction_last,
        run_col=run_col,
        frame_col=frame_col,
        sort_col=sort_col,
    )

    late_top_df = top_df.merge(
        late_keys,
        on=[run_col, frame_col],
        how="inner",
    )

    frame_summary = (
        late_top_df
        .pivot_table(
            index=[*group_cols, run_col, frame_col, sort_col],
            columns="cluster_rank_particles",
            values="frac_total_particles_in_cluster",
            aggfunc="sum",
            fill_value=0.0,
        )
        .reset_index()
        .rename(columns={
            1: "top1_material_frac",
            2: "top2_material_frac",
        })
    )

    if "top1_material_frac" not in frame_summary.columns:
        frame_summary["top1_material_frac"] = 0.0

    if "top2_material_frac" not in frame_summary.columns:
        frame_summary["top2_material_frac"] = 0.0

    frame_summary["top12_material_frac"] = (
        frame_summary["top1_material_frac"]
        + frame_summary["top2_material_frac"]
    )

    rep_summary = (
        frame_summary
        .groupby([*group_cols, run_col], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            top1_material_frac=("top1_material_frac", "mean"),
            top2_material_frac=("top2_material_frac", "mean"),
            top12_material_frac=("top12_material_frac", "mean"),
        )
    )

    summary = (
        rep_summary
        .groupby(group_cols, as_index=False)
        .agg(
            top1_material_frac=("top1_material_frac", "mean"),
            top2_material_frac=("top2_material_frac", "mean"),
            top12_material_frac=("top12_material_frac", "mean"),
            n_replicates=(run_col, "nunique"),
        )
    )

    return summary, rep_summary

def plot_top12_material_fraction(
    summary_df: pd.DataFrame,
    x_col: str = "E_att",
    style: PlotStyle | None = None,
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = LABEL_MAP,
    title: str | None = None,
    figsize: tuple[float, float] = (7.2, 5.2),
    ylim: tuple[float, float] = (0, 1.05),
) -> tuple[plt.Figure, plt.Axes]:
    """
    Plot top-1 and top-1+top-2 material fractions.

    Bottom bar segment = top 1.
    Upper bar segment = additional material in top 2.
    Full bar height = top 1 + top 2.
    """
    if style is None:
        style = PlotStyle()

    with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
        d = summary_df.sort_values(x_col).copy()

        x_values = d[x_col].to_list()
        x = np.arange(len(x_values))

        top1 = d["top1_material_frac"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        top2 = d["top2_material_frac"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        top12 = d["top12_material_frac"].to_numpy(dtype=float)

        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)

        ax.bar(
            x,
            top1,
            color="#5aafdc",
            edgecolor="none",
            width=0.68,
            label="top 1",
        )

        ax.bar(
            x,
            top2,
            bottom=top1,
            color="#eb5353",
            edgecolor="none",
            width=0.68,
            label="top 2 additional",
        )

        for i, (t1, t12) in enumerate(zip(top1, top12)):
            ax.text(
                i,
                t1 / 2,
                f"{t1:.2f}",
                ha="center",
                va="center",
                fontsize=11,
                color="white",
                fontweight="medium",
            )

            ax.text(
                i,
                t12 + 0.025,
                f"top1+2={t12:.2f}",
                ha="center",
                va="bottom",
                fontsize=11,
                color="black",
            )

        ax.set_xticks(x)
        ax.set_xticklabels([
            f"{value:g}"
            if isinstance(value, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating))
            else str(value)
            for value in x_values
        ])

        ax.set_xlabel(get_label(x_col, label_map))
        ax.set_ylabel("Fraction of total particles")
        ax.set_ylim(*ylim)

        if style.show_grid:
            ax.grid(True, axis="y", alpha=style.grid_alpha)

        ax.legend(
            loc="lower center",
            bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.24),
            ncol=2,
            frameon=True,
            fontsize=style.legend_size,
        )

        if title is not None:
            fig.suptitle(title, y=0.98, fontsize=style.title_size)

        fig.tight_layout(rect=(0.02, 0.14, 0.98, 0.93))

    return fig, ax

def make_cluster_time_df(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    group_cols: list[str],
    top_n: int = 3,
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    frame_col: str = "frame",
    sort_col: str = "step",
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Build framewise cluster-bin time dataframe.

    Output has one row per run/frame/cluster_bin.
    Values are summed across clusters inside each bin.
    """
    df = add_cluster_bin(df, top_n=top_n)

    group_cols_full = [
        *group_cols,
        run_col,
        frame_col,
        sort_col,
        "cluster_bin",
    ]

    out = (
        df
        .groupby(group_cols_full, as_index=False)
        .agg(
            frac_total_particles=("frac_total_particles_in_cluster", "sum"),
            frac_total_particles_cag10=("frac_total_particles_cag10_in_cluster", "sum"),
            frac_total_particles_cag47=("frac_total_particles_cag47_in_cluster", "sum"),
            n_mols_cag10=("n_mols_cag10", "sum"),
            n_mols_cag47=("n_mols_cag47", "sum"),
            n_clusters_aggregated=("n_clusters_aggregated", "sum"),
            inter_contact_saturation_cag10=("inter_contact_saturation_cag10", "mean"),
            inter_contact_saturation_cag47=("inter_contact_saturation_cag47", "mean"),
            intra_contact_saturation_cag10=("intra_contact_saturation_cag10", "mean"),
            intra_contact_saturation_cag47=("intra_contact_saturation_cag47", "mean"),
        )
    )

    # Fill missing categories per frame with zero.
    frame_base = df[
        [*group_cols, run_col, frame_col, sort_col]
    ].drop_duplicates()

    category_df = pd.DataFrame({"cluster_bin": CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER})

    grid = (
        frame_base.assign(_tmp=1)
        .merge(category_df.assign(_tmp=1), on="_tmp")
        .drop(columns="_tmp")
    )

    out = grid.merge(
        out,
        on=[*group_cols, run_col, frame_col, sort_col, "cluster_bin"],
        how="left",
    )

    fill_cols = [
        "frac_total_particles",
        "frac_total_particles_cag10",
        "frac_total_particles_cag47",
        "n_mols_cag10",
        "n_mols_cag47",
        "n_clusters_aggregated",
    ]

    out[fill_cols] = out[fill_cols].fillna(0.0)

    return out

def plot_cluster_bins_over_time(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    ax: plt.Axes,
    group_value: float | int,
    group_col: str = "E_att",
    run_col: str = "run_id",
    x_col: str = "step",
    y_col: str = "frac_total_particles",
    x_scale: float = 1e6,
    smoothing_window: int | None = 25,
    style: PlotStyle | None = None,
) -> plt.Axes:
    """
    Plot mean cluster-bin material fractions over time.

    Lines show replicate means over time for each cluster bin.
    """
    if style is None:
        style = PlotStyle()

    d = df[df[group_col] == group_value].copy()
    d = d.sort_values([run_col, "cluster_bin", x_col])

    if smoothing_window is not None and smoothing_window > 1:
        d[y_col] = (
            d
            .groupby([run_col, "cluster_bin"])[y_col]
            .transform(
                lambda s: s.rolling(
                    smoothing_window,
                    min_periods=1,
                    center=True,
                ).mean()
            )
        )

    mean_df = (
        d
        .groupby([x_col, "cluster_bin"], as_index=False)
        .agg(value=(y_col, "mean"))
    )

    for cluster_bin in CLUSTER_BIN_ORDER:
        dd = mean_df[mean_df["cluster_bin"] == cluster_bin]

        ax.plot(
            dd[x_col] / x_scale,
            dd["value"],
            label=cluster_bin,
            lw=style.mean_lw,
        )

    ax.set_title(f"{get_label(group_col, LABEL_MAP)} = {group_value}")
    ax.set_xlabel("Simulation step (×10⁶)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Fraction of total particles")
    ax.set_ylim(0, 1)

    if style.show_grid:
        ax.grid(True, alpha=style.grid_alpha)

    return ax
